newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey tenders January 13 to export 50,000 T sugar.
newsitem.headline: Turkey tenders January 13 to export 50,000 T sugar.

text.p: Turkey's state sugar refineries, Turkseker, invited bids on Friday for a tender to export up to 50,000 tonnes of white sugar, the Official Gazette said.
It said the company would collect bids by January 13 and assess them on the same day.
The tender announcement said Turkseker, which last week offered to sell Iran and Iraq 50,000 tonnes of sugar each, would not accept bids for amounts lower than 2,000 tonnes.
Turkseker said earlier it planned exports of up to 300,000 tonnes from its stocks, boosted by a better harvest in 1996/97 than the previous year.

Turkey is expected to produce 1.85 million tonnes of sugar in 1996/97, up from 1.5 million tonnes a year earlier. Its total supply is estimated to exceed two million tonnes with imports earlier in 1996.
